programme: Certified Return Bridges and First-Return Policy Improvement v1
retained_source: One bounded current-run Exalt trial with complete paid Annul return, native first-return evaluation and independent repeated-graph promotion.
measurement_notes: Frozen Ring 4-GiB/50M and Amulet 1-GiB/100M references are not reset to their more expensive original or first-incumbent costs.
All four final comparison pairs use the existing strict input/runtime identity checks, without exclusions or missing cases.
The intermediate Amulet host reservation mismatch is diagnostic only; its exclusion is retained in qualification.json. The final run restores the original runner setting.
Progress-sample first finite uppers are observation times, not exact verification-event timestamps.
Native total wall includes preparation, solve, compilation, independent evaluation and serialization. Process supervision wall is recorded separately.
Native peak owned bytes is an estimate. Process working sets are snapshots, not process peak measurements.
Cost authority is independent native graph evaluation, never a source-node expected_cost annotation or lower value.
The two-variant runs preserve failed gated-reforge attempts. Their incomplete laws have no claimed finite Q/r/q/repeated cost.
Wand and Shield are exposed controls despite historical directory names.
The preserved core/exposed baseline predates the predecessor's final neutral description text. Only description is removed for unchanged-graph comparisons; all remaining JSON must match.
The one changed Ring graph has 1000 fresh native trials, including 22 action-limit failures; see sampling.json. No unchanged graph is resampled.
Original-profile Ring has genuine wall-time and peak-owned-memory regression flags; policy quality improves within unchanged caps. This is not a universal performance-nonregression claim.

The report's reforge_work delta uses its historical metric projection. The full work.reforge_work retained below is the logical-work authority and records additional final-refinement work on original-profile Ring.
